serialization: Python standard-library pickle with .pt suffix; PyTorch is not required

top_level.trajectory: ordered list of exactly 40 round records

round_fields.query_index: row index in the public outcome-free candidate table
round_fields.condition: all public condition variables at query_index
round_fields.best_so_far: maximum observed yield through this round
round_fields.predicted_yield: pre-query surrogate mean for the selected candidate
round_fields.selection_mode: expected improvement or frozen uniform exploration

metric_definitions.round_to_95_global_best: first step with best_so_far >= 0.95*global_best; 41 if not reached
metric_definitions.AUC_best_so_far: arithmetic mean of the 40 best_so_far values
